proposals.evidence: DEDR 2426 explicitly compares Tamil cā, Kannada sāy (past sattu), Gondi hā-/sāy-, Kurux khē’enā (keccas), Malto keye and Brahui kahing die. Only the intransitive verb is proposed here; derived causative kill responses require a distinct relation analysis. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
